title: Knuckle
summary: KNUCK'LE, noun nuk'l. 1. The joint of a finger, particularly when protuberant by the closing of the fingers. 2. The knee join of a calf; as a knuckle of veal. 3. The joint of a plant. [Not used.] KNUC

inlines.v: KNUCK'LE, noun nuk'l. 1. The joint of a finger, particularly when protuberant by the closing of the fingers. 2. The knee join of a calf; as a knuckle of veal. 3. The joint of a plant. [Not used.] KNUCK'LE, verb intransitive nuk'l. To yield; to submit in contest to an antagonist.
